summary: The Ark-attack carve-out widened again for voyages: kaiju (4.5x grazers born outside a hostile cell's membrane) and open-water raiders now wear an IFaunaLeash held by VoyageRun that steers them at the Ark and orders its nearest hull plate; voyage satellite cells scatter fauna and flora births through the cytoplasm (Cell.ScatterLifeSpawns).
why: Shombith 2026-11-17: voyage cells felt small, every crystal came in one spot, and he asked for kaiju-level fauna attacking the cell from outside.
